top.line: Paying a bill took two clerks and one card network; AI's real impact is in such small failures, with code for the money.

in-short.line: Two clerks; not one company; small things; the one job; code for money, AI for change; wallets.

failures.line: An invoice that works, a system that cannot take payment, one that half works, one card network.

mvd.line: Taking the payment is the one job that must work with everything else on fire.

line.line: Reliable auditable code for the money; AI to find failures and drive the change.

wallets.line: Agents with small budgets and single-use cards, under a behaviour policy.

one.line: One small problem at a time, fixed, recorded and checked.

limits.line: One visit, the company unnamed; agents with wallets is my position.

sources.line: My visit, the PrompTugal.news original, Multibanco sources and earlier articles.
